QuestInfo.0: After a whole lot of flapping, you've arrived at Chryse! Now, why does it look all smashed up?
QuestInfo.1:
Demos isn't much help. You'll have to talk to Chief Marione at the Chryse Hideout for the whole story.
To get inside the Hideout, you need an Entry Pass. Beat up the Rabbits Outside of Chryse 1 or 2 until you find the one that nicked it from Demos.
QuestInfo.2: You got your very own Entry Pass! Time to get some answers from Chief Marione.
QuestInfo.name: Welcome to Chryse
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 13,860\nCan proceed to the Chief Concerns quest.\n
